subject: Vendor portal provisioning: scoped CAIQ trim & evidence de-dup playbook
messages:
From: Claire Wu <claire.wu@greenleafsys.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@greenleafsys.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal provisioning request — scoped CAIQ/ SIG mapping

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. GreenLeaf is ready to start the vendor portal onboarding for Redwood (we prefer Vendr but can use Whistic if needed). We want to avoid uploading the entire SOC 2 artifact bucket and instead provide a minimal set that maps to the CAIQ controls you requested during the RFP.

High level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood accept a scoped CAIQ mapping with links to SOC2 artifacts (instead of full re-upload)?
- Do you support a presign S3 upload flow for large evidence files?
- Any guidance on de-duping artifacts (we have overlap between SOC2 report PDFs, system diagrams, and control response spreadsheets).

I've attached a short SOC2 summary and indicated which fields we think should be canonical in the portal. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through.

Cheers,
Claire
Claire Wu
Security Operations Manager
GreenLeaf Systems
Attachments: greenleaf_soc2_summary_2027.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Wu <claire.wu@greenleafsys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal provisioning request — scoped CAIQ/ SIG mapping

Hi Claire — thanks for the summary and the attachment. Glad to see GreenLeaf already organized the SOC2 artifacts; that will make a minimal onboarding much faster. Quick plan below, aiming to minimize upload and avoid duplicate evidence in the portal: 

1) Scoped CAIQ mapping we accept
- We can ingest a CAIQ mapping CSV that references canonical artifacts (URL or S3 presign). We will persist the mapping and mark samples as authoritative.

2) Evidence de-dup playbook (recommended)
- You provide a single canonical copy per evidence type (SOC2 report PDF, network diagram, pen test report).
- For documents reused across multiple CAIQ/SIG questions, include a short manifest row indicating the canonical filename and the list of control IDs it satisfies.
- Our intake will attach the canonical artifact once and reference it from multiple questions — no duplicates stored.

3) Presign / upload options
- Presigned S3 uploads: supported. We will generate time-limited presign URLs scoped to the evidence manifest. Recommended for >20MB files.
- Vendr API: if you prefer programmatic ingest we can accept the API tokens; we will provide a scoped API key limited to profile uploads.

4) Timeline & next steps
- If you can fill the attached "evidence-manifest-template.csv" with canonical filenames + control mapping, we can create a provisional profile in Vendr by Monday and open a 48-hour presign window for uploads.
- Ben (cc) will validate any encryption/KMS requirements. Naomi (cc) will be the portal steward at Redwood to finalize ownership and TTL.

Security notes: please ensure any presigned URLs are uploaded over TLS and that the canonical artifacts do not include production secrets (we'll redact if found and ask you to re-provide).

If this plan works, can you confirm by EOD today and attach the filled manifest? I can spin up the provisional profile after that.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Sr. Security PM, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachments: evidence-manifest-template.csv
From: Claire Wu <claire.wu@greenleafsys.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, onboarding@greenleafsys.com
Date: Sun, 16 Jun 2028 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal provisioning request — scoped CAIQ/ SIG mapping

Thanks Marcus — this is exactly the level of detail we were hoping for.

Action items from our side:
- I'll populate the evidence-manifest-template.csv with canonical filenames and control mappings and push it back by Monday morning.
- We prefer the S3 presign flow for two large pen test artifacts — please go ahead and create the provisional profile and a presign window once you have the manifest.
- Our compliance team asked if Redwood can accept a single SOC2 report PDF plus an appendix ZIP for raw logs (we will presign the ZIP). Is there a size limit we should be aware of?

Ben/Naomi — thanks for jumping in. Ben, Claire flagged potential KMS provenance requirements; can you advise whether our existing envelope encryption model is acceptable or if you need separate key custody evidence?

I can do a quick 20-min call Tuesday to walk through the manifest if that's helpful.

Best,
Claire Wu
Security Operations Manager
GreenLeaf Systems
Attachments: (none)
